entities.summary: Kostas Sarantidis, also known in Vietnamese as Nguyễn Văn Lập, was a Greek captain of the People's Army of Vietnam who fought with the Viet Minh during the First Indochina War, seeking independence for Vietnam from the French colonial empire. He received Vietnamese citizenship in 2010 and in 2013, he was awarded the Hero of the People's Armed Forces order.
